Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Hey there,

dunno if this one has been asked, couldn't find the answer, so :

"Rise of the Nephtali : Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire becomes
a
Liaison. Requires at least one other Gehenna card in play. Any
Independent
vampire may take an action to become liaison. Liaison is a unique
Independent title worth 4 votes. If this title would be contested with
a
younger vampire, the younger vampire immediately yields instead of
contesting."

Someone is Liaison. A younger vampire contests, and therefore yields.
Does
the older vampire just "stay" liaison, or is there the usual "at his
next
untap" clause, at which time he will regain the title ?

Orpheus, necromonger.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Someone is Liaison. A younger vampire contests, and therefore yields.
